That recovery feels right. When I signed in with the wrong password, it kept my email address filled in so I didn't have to retype it — just cleared the password box for me to try again — and the message stayed general rather than announcing "that email doesn't exist" or "wrong password." I actually like that it's vague: since this is my private collection, I don't want it confirming to anyone poking at it whether they've hit a real account or not. And then "bookmarks" got me straight in.

So it's the right blend — quick and forgiving for me when I fat-finger my password, but not chatty about the details. Good. What's next?
